caption: The drawing displays three representations of a rectangular leather satchel on a plain off-white background. The top left shows the satchel's front view with the flap closed, rendered in shades of dark brown, and features ornate embossed detailing and a central oval medallion that appears to hold an eagle or similar insignia; a strap hangs down from the middle of the flap. To the right, a three-dimensional view of the same satchel is presented with the flap open, displaying the light brown underside of the flap, a protruding strap, and a visible inner compartment with an additional pocket on the exterior of the case; the body of the satchel is shaded in darker browns for depth. Slightly above this open satchel is a small geometric maker's stamp stating "MADE BY S. MOORE N. YORK." At the bottom left of the composition is a simple, uncolored line drawing of the satchel viewed from the front, showing the outlines of two buckles and the basic shape without additional detail or shading. The name “Stella Master” is written faintly below the open satchel.
title: Mail Pouch
